id.description: Lower-case kebab-case. Must match the filename without .json.

title.description: The resource’s own title, as its publisher writes it.

url.description: Must start with https:// and contain no spaces, or be "#" if genuinely unavailable.
url.markdownDescription:
**Link to the resource.**

Must start with `https://` and contain **no whitespace** — a space here means a column got misaligned on import, which has happened before and silently broke five links.

Use `#` only if no public URL exists.
